{"arguments": {"content": "import sys
import openpyxl

input_path, output_path = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb['Sheet1']

# I4 = Today (2021-01-11). Sum sales for the last four weekday dates up to
# (and including) the date in I4, excluding weekends. Since weekends have no
# data, use an array formula that finds the 4th-largest qualifying date and
# sums all values on dates between that and I4.
formula = (
    '=SUMPRODUCT((A2:A31<=I4)*(WEEKDAY(A2:A31,2)<6)*(B2:B31)*'
    '(A2:A31>=LARGE(IF((A2:A31<=I4)*(WEEKDAY(A2:A31,2)<6),A2:A31),4)))'
)
ws['I6'] = formula

wb.save(output_path)
print("Saved", output_path)", "path": "/bench/answers/58109/solution.py"}, "name": "write"}
